task.title: The merge gate never lints three_rings' release-only code
task.description:
Found 2026-08-16 during the deep-link fix, with a live bite: the gate's clippy line for the Tauri shell (cargo clippy --workspace ... and cargo build -p three_rings) runs at DEV profile only, so every #[cfg(not(debug_assertions))] block in src-tauri/src/lib.rs — which is MOST of that file, since the embedded server only exists in release builds — is invisible to the gate. The deep-link worker's first fix attempt compiled clean under the gate's exact commands but failed the real Android release build with E0282/E0277 (caught only because the worker also ran release-profile clippy by choice). Per the repo contract the suite is the de facto reviewer — a wrong-but-green change to release-only shell code ships itself.

Fix: add a release-profile lint/build line for the shell to .github/workflows/validate.yml (e.g. cargo clippy -p three_rings --release --all-targets -- -D warnings, or cargo build -p three_rings --release), weigh CI-minutes cost vs coverage, and mirror it in CLAUDE.md's reproduce-the-gate list + the validate skill. Note the container exclusion story stays the same (three_rings never builds in-container).
